name: Colomera (Spain)
description: Divided by a red diagonal band from the lower hoist to the upper fly, green above and blue below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Colomera (a dove and a tower).
history: Municipal flag of Colomera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: band from the lower hoist to the upper fly
